Station walks first

Know what you’re going out for.

Official directories supply branch addresses, hours and point information. We compare up to ten distinct retailers per station, with other branches expandable. Coverage is a researched sample; the number of retailers varies. Published walking times and calculated straight-line distances are labeled separately; follow directions for the actual route. Station coordinates: HeartRails Express.

Flyer titles and date ranges are refreshed separately from store details. Expired flyers disappear; a flyer checked more than three days ago stops being shown as current. Publication periods can differ from item sale dates. Open the retailer’s original flyer for prices and stock. Coverage & refresh status

The optional search uses multilingual MiniLM locally. It finds relevant point notices; it cannot decide your eligibility or confirm a sale. Read the conditions shown with each result. Model & evaluation

Station Points · made for everyday trips in JapanIndependent project · no retailer affiliation
